metadata.description: Agent skills for spec-driven delivery — one plugin for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode. Foreman coordinates a fresh-context Draft → Review → Forge → Review → Land loop; Cast frames projects, Spec creates feature and quick contracts, and Temper learns from shipped work.

plugins.name: valcraft
plugins.description: Reusable agent skills: cast (project framing), spec (feature and quick contracts), draft (task plans with MSW), forge (reviewed-task implementation and authorized task PRs), review (report-only plan, code, and evidence review), land (authorized finalization and tracker closure), foreman (named-state delivery coordination), temper (retrospective production and authorized PRs), hone (prompt refinement), distill (prompt distillation), and msw (MSW Kernel document judgment).
